subject: s-proj
title: S.PROJ.------T.C.IMP.
description: Diagram in WI-22, on the page where Braxton clarifies that 'the concept of the grand trade-off pertains to the essence lining that determines the vibrational nature of events in this cycle' — that western art music is treated as 'more than the merely natural' while every progressional period of music from the white improvisor 'has always been viewed as a more sophisticated offering' than its black counterparts. S-PROJ (source projection) is crossed with T-C-IMP (time continuum implications): the question is what source projection looks like when crossed with time-continuum implications in this 'sophistication' regime. S-PROJ → T-C-IMP. S-PROJ also branches to TR-INFO (trans-information), which branches to A-PR (all-purpose), AFL-DY (affinity dynamics), and RE-ST (restructuralism). RE-ST branches to LANG-DY (language dynamics) → C-FO-ACT (composite focused activism) and to INDIV-TD (individual tendencies) → PHY-U-P (physical universe particular) → POL-P (political policies) → PART (participation). Political policies also bears directly on participation.
